nextCredentialingDate.description: Next credentialing date from the latest credentialing workflow (as string)

credentialingStatus.description: Credentialing status from the latest credentialing workflow

credentialingCycle.description: Authoritative credentialing cycle for this practitioner (CP-38827): "Recredentialing" when an approved credentialing workflow already exists or the practitioner's operational-value data already carries lastCredentialedDate/nextCredentialingDate; "Initial" otherwise. Derived at read time using the same rule CredentialingWorkflowService applies at workflow creation. Returned as explicit null if the underlying derivation fails or the feature is disabled for this tenant/environment.

practitionerStatus.description: Practitioner status derived from relationship windows and core termination date (INACTIVE, PENDING, ACTIVE, IN_NETWORK, TERMINATED)

credentialingDueDate.description: Credentialing due date from the latest credentialing workflow (as string). Serialized as credentialingDueDate; populated by CP-32265 from the top-level credentialingDueDate emitted by the DAL. Output-only (not bound on request deserialization).

anchorDate.description: Platform-computed Anchor Date (read-only); absent outside Anchor Groups. Populated on the detail read only, never on list rows.

nextSharedCredentialingDate.description: Next Shared Credentialing Date (read-only); absent until a shared cycle establishes it. Populated on the detail read only.

anchorEligibility.description: Anchor participation eligibility for this practitioner–tenant. Populated on the detail read only.

terminationDate.description: Termination effective date (YYYY-MM-DD), present only if the practitioner has been terminated

terminationReason.description: Termination reason, present only if the practitioner has been terminated

eligibilityDeterminations.description: Append-only credentialing / contracting eligibility determinations (CP-40120). Omitted when the provider has none. The effective status per scope is derived at read time: latest createdAt wins.

status.description: Eligibility verdict for this practitioner–tenant: ELIGIBLE or INELIGIBLE.

participating.description: Ops participation flag for display: the override when Operations set one, otherwise the eligibility verdict.

exclusionReasons.description: The stored failing reasons. One entry today: the engine evaluates every rule but stores the single highest-precedence reason.

unsupportedStates.description: States to Credential the Anchor Group does not support; present exactly when the exclusion reason is state-based (empty if configuration has since changed).

EligibilityDeterminationResponse.description: One append-only eligibility determination element (CP-40120). The effective status per scope is derived at read time: latest createdAt wins.

scope.description: Configured dimensions (states, linesOfBusiness, practitionerTypes, specialties) to values; an empty list means every value, all empty means global

sourceId.description: Writer and upload that produced this element, e.g. roster:<rosterId>

code.description: Catalogue code of the failing rule, e.g. STATE_NOT_ELIGIBLE.

description.description: Human wording for the failing rule, from the reasons catalogue.
